reason: Fixed issue #8 defect 1 with TDD. Both scanner lanes now admit a line-leading committed markup opening as a statement start (at_line_start && committed_jsx_opening, still excluding TS type-parameter forms). That alone was insufficient: the projected TSX still applied standard JS ASI, so the scanner records each such offset in a new Overlay::statement_boundaries and both projection lanes emit a `;` before the authored `<`, keeping every authored byte copied verbatim and every span mappable. Five tests added; full workspace tests and clippy green. Defect 2 (Oxfmt refusal on a trailing @if) survives and is a different root cause: code_context returns Expression for a line-leading @ control after a semicolon-less statement.
